title: Let seeking become service
summary: This meets the hunger that keeps searching without landing. The line says release is not found by roaming, but by the True Name and service to the True Guru.
lifeApplication: When the mind wants one more spiritual novelty, stop at the threshold and bow into the path already given. Serve before you search again.

source.shortMeaning: Release is found through the Name and service to the Guru.
source.lifeApplication: Before searching for more, serve where the Guru has already placed you.

evidence.coreClaim: Release is found through the Name and service to the Guru.
evidence.turn: Seeking matures when it bows into the Name and service.
evidence.practicalImplication: When the mind wants one more spiritual novelty, stop at the threshold and bow into the path already given. Serve before you search again.
